AceDB does not work that way. When db.profile is first indexed, initSection -> copyDefaults rawsets every scalar default into sv.profiles[activeKey] (AceDB-3.0.lua:186-196, copyDefaults :129-131 `rawset(dest, k, v)`). The same thing happens to any profile initialized in that session. removeDefaults strips those keys only at logout (:425). So if RunMigrations runs after anything has touched NS.db.profile, the raw `profiles` walk sees merged defaults in the active profile as if they were stored values. An author who follows this sentence and treats 'key present' as 'user-set' will migrate default values as user choices for the active profile only. That is the kind of silent SV corruption the ruling is meant to prevent. The text should say the runner must run before db.profile is first read, or that a step must not tell stored values from defaults by key presence.
